source: KITScenes-LongTail Dataset (KIT-MRT / Wagner et al., arXiv:2603.23607, 2026)
provenance: Extracted directly from official HuggingFace dataset card (pinhole camera model)

documented_facts: Vehicle platform is a BMW 7 Series sedan (Wagner et al., arXiv:2603.23607).
Source cameras produce 3488x2272 pinhole format images, downscaled to 876x568 for the competition.
Camera intrinsic matrices K and extrinsic matrices (R, t) for all 6 surround cameras are published directly in the official dataset card.
Ego-vehicle trajectory coordinates originate from KISS-ICP LiDAR odometry aligned across point clouds, projected to 2D BEV (x, y, yaw), and smoothed via an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF).
inferred_working_conventions: LiDAR origin co-location: KISS-ICP odometry origin (x=0, y=0, yaw=0 at t=0) is assumed co-located with the roof sensor reference frame origin for extrinsic transformations.

Nominal road elevation: Z_road = -1.60 m is an empirical estimate based on the BMW 7 Series roof-to-ground height (~1.48 m vehicle roof + ~0.16 m mount); the paper does not publish per-scenario ground-plane height maps.

coordinate_system.reference_frame: Primary Roof Sensor Frame (t=0 LiDAR Scanning Center)
coordinate_system.description: Origin (0,0,0) is located at the center of the primary roof LiDAR sensor at t=0.0s. All camera extrinsics (R, t) and KISS-ICP LiDAR odometry trajectories are registered in this frame.

sensor_geometry.ground_height_provenance: Nominal empirical road elevation relative to roof LiDAR on BMW 7 Series test vehicle. The road surface is approximately 1.60 m below the roof LiDAR sensor, placing the camera optical centers at ~1.41 m above the pavement.

coordinate_system.transformation: P_camera = R @ P_ref + t = R @ (P_ref - C) where C = -R.T @ t

source_image_dimensions.description: Original pinhole image format optimized for 16x16 px patches (ViTs)
